Class WriteMappingBuilder<TRow>

Namespace
ParquetNeo.Serialization.Generated
Assembly
ParquetNeo.Serialization.dll

Describes how a row type is written as columns, and gets the code that gives the values of each object to them. What the source generator writes for a type uses it, and nothing at run time looks at the type: no reflection, and no code is compiled. Not for use in code you write yourself.

public sealed class WriteMappingBuilder<TRow>

Remarks

The properties are described in the order of their columns, depth first: Leaf<TValue>(string?, string?, bool, ColumnSettings?, ParquetEncoding?, DictionarySettings?) for one that is a column of its own, and for an object, a collection or a dictionary a Begin call, what is inside it, and End(). In a collection the element is described, and in a dictionary the key and then the value; they have no names.
